mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, stall_id, subtotal, discount_total, total_amount, payment_method, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{stallId}, #{subtotal}, #{discountTotal}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, menu_item_id, item_name, unit_price, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{menuItemId}, #{itemName}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, subtotal, discount_total, total_amount, payment_method, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, order_id, menu_item_id, item_name, unit_price, quantity FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.stall_id, o.subtotal, o.discount_total, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.status, o.created_at, s.name AS stall_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN stalls s ON s.id = o.stall_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.stall_id, o.order_group_id, o.subtotal, o.discount_total, o.total_amount, o.payment_method, o.status, o.created_at, u.username AS username, s.name AS stall_name FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN stalls s ON s.id = o.stall_id ORDER BY o.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId} AND stall_id = #{stallId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} AND status = #{status}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN menu_items m ON m.id = oi.menu_item_id WHERE m.stall_id = #{stallId} AND DATE(o.created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT id, order_id, status, changed_at FROM order_status_logs WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'READY'

SELECT s.name AS stall_name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM stalls s LEFT JOIN menu_items m ON m.stall_id = s.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.menu_item_id = m.id WHERE s.id = #{stallId} GROUP BY s.id, s.name

SELECT s.name AS stall_name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM stalls s LEFT JOIN menu_items m ON m.stall_id = s.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.menu_item_id = m.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY s.id
SELECT NULL AS stall_name, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, IFNULL(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN menu_items m ON m.id = oi.menu_item_id WHERE m.stall_id = #{stallId} AND o.created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
